eligibility.rule: A player must belong to the 2024 NFL hobby/player class or be an established NFL player appearing in the 2024 product. Product branding alone does not move a later rookie into 2024 Team Hunt.
excludeFrom2024TeamHunt: 2025 rookie-class players appearing only as 2024 Select XRC redemptions
2025 rookie-class players such as Cam Ward, Ashton Jeanty, Jaxson Dart, Shedeur Sanders and Travis Hunter
future-class prospects and unverified checklist entries
eligibility.selectXRCPolicy: Keep 2024 Select XRC records in the product checklist for completeness, but tag them xrc=true and teamHuntEligible2024=false. Never surface them as 2024 team rookie targets.

teamHuntRanking: Legend only when product/team relevance makes it useful

requirements: no dark or badly exposed listing photo
no distracting hand or clutter when a cleaner source exists
prefer raw card over slab when image quality is comparable
referenceImage.variety: Rotate major products and chase types. Do not use the same card design for all 32 teams.

checklistUX.primaryFlow: Sport > Year > Team > Team Hunt page
teamPage: exact hits to hunt expandable inline
one master checklist grouped by product
checklistUX.navigation: Back returns to the immediate previous CardStorm state and preserves team/year/scroll state; it must not default to Home.
checklistUX.productChecklist: Full product checklist remains a secondary destination.

deploymentGate: 32 production image files localized and visually QA'd
no invented unreleased or unverified checklist data
native and in-app Back navigation QA complete
homepage hero and unrelated Command Center modules unchanged
